model.default_rule: arithmetic mean of same-operation affine training trend and complementary-operation exact training anchor
model.paired_trough_rule: preserve the complementary exact anchor when it is below both adjacent anchors of its own operation

small_reduce_scatter_rule.rule: maximum of symmetric value, same-operation affine value and complementary all-gather exact anchor

rules.scaled_term: symmetric value above the same curve's minimum training latency

model.off_grid_rule: same-operation affine interpolation on true bytes
model.completion_semantics: opaque fully local completion charged once

family_h.band: relative error no greater than max(0.10, two H200 GPU cycles divided by measured completion)
